en: The One-Scroll *Five-Syllable Yoga Method of the Youthful Bodhisattva Mañjuśrī*.
Compiled by the Grand Master of the Court, Peer of the State, Acting Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial, Duke of Sui.

The Tripiṭaka Śramaṇa Amoghavajra—honored with a fief of three thousand households, invested with the purple robe, posthumously granted the title of Minister of Works (Sikong), and conferred the honorific name Dajian (Great Mirror)—translated this by imperial decree at Daguangzhi Daxingshan Temple. First: *Mam* (using the Peacock Throne mudrā as described above). Second: *Tirihi* (pronounced with four tones, as above). Next, the three-syllable mantra: *Vākī Hūṃ*. Next, the five-syllable mantra has five varieties.

First: *ara-pāca-na*. Second: *oṃ vajra-tīkṣṇa* (pronounced as a single word). Third: *oṃ nūkha-cī-na*. Fourth: *oṃ kṣaga-ghra-khaṃ*. Fifth: *oṃ kṣaga-sat-tva*. These are the six types of yoga mantras consisting of six syllables.

Oṃ vajragīte namaḥ | Oṃ vajragīte raṭe jaya | Oṃ vajragīte śīle svāhā | Oṃ vajragīte kṣaṇe jaya | Oṃ vajragīte nijaṃ jaya | Oṃ vajragīte maṇasā | Next, the mantra for the empowerment flask (kalaśa) is as follows:
Namaḥ siddhyai tathāgatāya namo hṛdaya-sarva-mūrdha-nābhi-raśmi-prabhāsvara-nābhi-śīma-nu-ni-ma-ha-ma-mala-vādi-mitra-le svāhā. This is the mantra for the accomplishment of the adornment of Bodhi.
Oṃ ru ci ra ma ni pra va ta ya hūṃ. Thus did the Great Holy Bodhisattva Mañjuśrī offer praise.
